title: shared hit target choice
rule: Checkbox and radio label and control share a single hit target (no dead zones).
pass_when: Click/tap on label, control, or the space between toggles the same choice.
fail_when: Dead zone between control and label; only the small control hits.
overview: Checkbox and radio label and control share one hit target with no dead zones.
apply_when: Checkbox or radio rows with visible labels beside the control.
not_when: Icon-only toggles without a separate text label to associate.
agent_hint: Make label, control, and space between one shared hit target.
description: Checkbox and radio label and control must share a single hit target with no dead zones. Pass when click or tap on label, control, or the space between toggles the same choice; fail when a dead zone sits between control and label and only the small control hits. Shared targets keep choices usable on touch and pointer alike.
